content_sections.heading: About BMH
content_sections.text: Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital (B.M.H.) is a hospital of the Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi (GNCTD) at H-4/5, Pitampura, Delhi-110034. This walk-in is run by the Office of the Medical Superintendent. The posts are filled under the Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All three posts are Senior Resident posts. They have the same qualification rule, age limit and pay. The only difference is an extra rule for Radiology, given below the table. According to the notice, the number of posts may vary and the vacancies may be filled in phases. If a post reserved for a category is left vacant because no eligible candidate is available, it may be filled from the unreserved category if unreserved candidates attend the interview. If no SC/ST/OBC candidates are available, the posts will be filled for 89 days on an ad hoc basis by the combined merit of all categories. MBBS Degree from an MCI recognized university with P.G./Diploma/DNB qualification in the respective speciality. The candidate must not have completed three years of Senior Residency in any recognized institution, counting both regular and ad hoc periods. If such candidates are not available in a speciality, others without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered. Registration of the PG/Diploma/DNB in the speciality with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. For the Radiology Senior Resident post, a valid MD/DNB degree is mandatory. Candidates with three years of experience but without the degree will not be considered. The qualification listed above applies. For these two posts, a candidate without a postgraduate qualification but with 02 years of experience in the concerned speciality may be considered, but only when no candidate with the PG/Diploma/DNB qualification is available. The notice states that registration with the Delhi Medical Council is compulsory. Candidates should have a valid DMC registration certificate at the time of the interview. A candidate who has only applied for DMC registration can show the receipt at the interview, but must submit a valid DMC Registration Certificate within 45 days of joining. Otherwise the candidature will be cancelled. The age limit for a Senior Resident is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC(Delhi) candidates, as on the date of the interview (30 October 2026). Only an OBC certificate issued in Delhi is accepted, and it must come with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification. Each Senior Resident is paid 67,700/- in Level-11 (Rs. 15,600-39,100 G.P 6600 pre-revised). The appointment is on an emergent and purely ad hoc basis. It lasts 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins against the post, whichever is earlier. There is 01 day of break after every 89 days. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring a photograph and a set of attested copies of all their certificates, along with the originals, for verification at the interview: Passport size photo Date of Birth Certificate (Xth Class) DMC Registration Degree/Diploma Certificate (MBBS, PG) Attempt Certificate of PG degree/diploma Internship Certificate Mark-Sheets of all years (10th, 12th, MBBS, PG) Caste Certificate (if applicable). Only a Delhi OBC certificate is accepted, with a non-creamy-layer certificate of the current year. Aadhar Card/Voter Card/Driving License/any valid photo I-card approved by Govt.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report on 30 October 2026 between 09:30 AM and 11:30 AM. Page 1 of the notice places the interview in the office of the Medical Superintendent, and page 2 gives the reporting place as Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital. Original certificates are checked against the attested copies, and selection and appointment are made through the interview. If not enough candidates are available, candidates may be considered under the relaxation in circular no. F.121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045 dated 10/06/2011 of the Dept. of H&FW, GNCTD, on these terms: The list of fresh candidates is used up first for appointment as Sr. Residents. The second list is used only after that. All Senior Resident appointments from the second list are for one year only and cannot be renewed after one year.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Appointment is subject to medical fitness and verification of educational certificates. Posts will be filled in phases, depending on the availability of vacancies and the needs of the department. The number of vacancies shown may change. The Competent Authority reserves the right to make any amendment, cancellation or change at any stage, during or after appointment. Candidates who have already completed three years of Senior Residency (regular and ad hoc) are not eligible. The notice was sent to the website of the H&FW Dept., GNCT of Delhi and to the Notice Board of B.M.H. for display.

faq.question: Q1. When is the BMH Senior Resident walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 October 2026, and the reporting time is 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the BMH Senior Resident walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: Candidates report to Room No.-132, B.M. Hospital, at Bhagwan Mahavir Hospital, GNCTD, Pitampura, Delhi-110034.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in BMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 Senior Resident vacancies: 2 in Radiology, 1 in Paediatrics and 1 in Medicine. The number of posts may vary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the BMH Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS Degree from an MCI recognized university with P.G./Diploma/DNB in the respective speciality, and must not have completed three years of Senior Residency. For Radiology, a valid MD/DNB degree is mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the BMH Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years for General, 50 years for SC/ST and 48 years for OBC(Delhi) candidates, as on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at BMH?
faq.answer: The pay is 67,700/- in Level-11 (Rs. 15,600-39,100 G.P 6600 pre-revised).

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the BMH walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring a passport size photo and attested copies with originals of these documents: Class X birth certificate, DMC registration, MBBS/PG certificates, PG attempt certificate, internship certificate, mark-sheets of all years, caste certificate if applicable, and a Govt.-approved photo ID.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BMH Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely ad hoc, for 89 days or until the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier, with a 01-day break after every 89 days.

faq.question: Q9. Can I attend the BMH interview without DMC registration?
faq.answer: Candidates who have applied for DMC registration can show the receipt at the interview. They must submit a valid DMC Registration Certificate within 45 days of joining, or their candidature will be cancelled.

faq.question: Q10. Will BMH pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.
